newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Systems/equipment makers started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Systems/equipment makers started.

text.p: -- PaineWebber analyst Gunnar Miller confirmed he started coverage of four systems and equipment makers.
-- Started FSI International Inc as buy.
-- Started Advanced Energy Industries Inc, Veeco Instruments Inc and PRI Automation Inc as attractive.
-- Set FSI earnings estimates at $0.36 per share for fiscal 1997 and $0.85 for 1998. 12-month target price is $19.
-- Set PRI estimates at $1.07 per share for fiscal 1997 and $1.40 for 1998. 12-month target is $38.
-- Set Veeco estimates at $1.65 per share for 1997 and $2.30 for 1998, which includes recent MRC acquisition. 12-month target is $48.
-- Set Advanced Energy estimates at $0.45 per share for 1997 and $0.90 for 1998. 12-month target is $13.
